text_block_list.text:
The strongest Umamusume has been
decided.
Симболи Рудольф basks in the
crowd's applause as
she holds her title
high. Next up: the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, Нарита Брайан, who was
watching the
race, comes by the waiting
room.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Their terse conversation ends with some
pointed
remarks from Brian about
Rudolf's insistence on
keeping up her
student council duties.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
